why: Claims every blocked-by list was read. The `reconcile` path marks each issue it did not inspect `loaded: false`/`blockersLoaded: false` while the list payload still says the issue has blockers, so under the mutation an issue known to be blocked is published with an empty, authoritative-looking blocker list -- the most damaging thing a dependency map can get wrong, because it presents blocked work as ready to start.
killedBy: snapshotIssue reports an unread relationship as unknown rather than as empty
